name: Investigate the Alchemist Shop
summary: Investigate the Alchemist Shop is an Undercity quest for Horde mages tasked with resolving an arcane anomaly in the Apothecarium. Guided by Anastasia Hartwell, practitioners track and capture invisible creatures made of pure magical energy running loose inside Algernon's shop.

sections.title: A Disturbance in the Apothecarium
sections.body: The Undercity is no stranger to unnatural phenomena, but the Apothecarium recently developed a problem of purely arcane origin. Unseen magical entities were detected wandering Algernon's alchemy shop, passing silently among bubbling cauldrons and toxic reagents. Recognizing an unnatural breach in the flow of magic, the Undercity's mage instructor, Anastasia Hartwell, directs promising arcane initiates to investigate and contain the entities before catastrophic damage occurs.

sections.title: Manifestation and Containment
sections.body: Because the entities are invisible and composed entirely of raw arcane force, ordinary tracking methods are useless. Anastasia equips her students with a specialized Cantation of Manifestation to strip away the entities' invisibility, alongside sturdy containment coffers. Once revealed, the volatile rift spawns must be battered down and sealed safely inside the coffers before they can unravel further or harm the alchemists at work.

sections.title: Accident or Arcane Assault?
sections.body: Upon securing the specimens, Anastasia's concern shifts to their origin. A spontaneous rift in the ambient flow of magic is troubling enough, but an intentional breach would imply an active, coordinated magical assault against the Forsaken capital. The captured creatures are turned over for study to determine whether the Apothecarium merely suffered an arcane accident or sits on the frontline of a targeted threat.

faq.q: Who gives this quest and where do I find them?
faq.answer: The quest is offered by Anastasia Hartwell, the mage trainer stationed in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
The disturbance is centered around Algernon's alchemy shop, located down within the Apothecarium district of the Undercity.

faq.q: What are the creatures wandering the shop?
faq.answer: They are rift spawns, invisible beings made entirely of concentrated magical energy that appeared through an anomaly in the local flow of magic.

faq.q: How do you capture the creatures?
faq.answer: You must recite the Cantation of Manifestation in the shop to reveal the rift spawns, weaken them with spells, and then deploy a containment coffer to trap them inside.

faq.q: Why does Anastasia want these creatures captured alive?
faq.answer: Anastasia and the Undercity's scholars need live specimens to determine whether the tear in magic was a natural, random rift or an intentional attack against the city by an outside magical force.

faq.q: Can classes other than mages do this quest?
faq.answer: No, this quest is specifically part of the early training lineage restricted entirely to Horde mages.

angles.text: This task tests an apprentice's mastery over pure arcane forces, demanding the use of specialized manifestation cantations and containment vessels rather than mere destructive force.
While Forsaken apothecaries focus heavily on alchemy and plaguecraft, this mission highlights the vigilance of the Undercity's arcane scholars in guarding their city from magical infiltration.
